# Livinis — Minimal tech for modern living

## About
Livinis (livinis.ch) is a Swiss hospitality automation company specialising in smart domotics for hotels, charme properties and private residences. Founded and operated from Switzerland, Livinis serves properties across Switzerland and Italy.

## Core offering
Livinis designs and installs end-to-end automation systems for the hospitality sector, integrating:
- Card-based access control with multi-level permissions (guest, housekeeping, maintenance, security, contractor)
- Climate management with per-room thermostats, window sensors and presence detection
- Lighting scenes and energy management
- PMS (Property Management System) integration via webhook API
- Garage access and vehicle management
- Security and alarm systems including voice-distress detection
- Real-time management via the Livinis Concierge dashboard

## Technology stack
- Edge hardware: Raspberry Pi running Home Assistant and Node-RED
- Cloud: Google App Engine, Cloud SQL (MySQL), Google Drive sync
- Connectivity: Tailscale VPN
- Sync interval: 60 seconds cloud-to-edge
- Thermal integration: LG systems, Microdevice
- PMS compatibility: Clock PMS and others via webhook

## Key differentiators
- Minimal, non-intrusive hardware design branded Livinis
- Single-file cloud-to-edge sync architecture for offline resilience
- Full PMS integration: check-in automatically activates keycards, checkout disables them
- Multi-level access: guest, housekeeping, security, maintenance, contractor, manager
- Do-not-disturb enforcement via keycard pocket sensors
- Voice distress detection for guest and staff safety
- ESG-ready energy reporting
- Scales from single apartments to multi-building hotel complexes

## How the system works
1. PMS triggers a webhook event (check-in, checkout, key change)
2. Livinis cloud API (Google App Engine) processes the event and updates Cloud SQL
3. Per-property JSON files are written to Google Drive
4. Raspberry Pi units sync from Drive every 60 seconds via rclone
5. Home Assistant / Node-RED automations execute: unlock doors, set temperatures, control lighting

## Access control detail
- Keycard types: guest, housekeeping, security, maintenance, contractor, master
- Validity: ISO 8601 datetime range (from check-in to check-out + 11:00)
- Multi-room assignment: one card can open multiple doors (e.g. parent accessing child's room)
- DND (Do Not Disturb): housekeeping cards blocked when guest card is in room pocket
- Drop-box checkout: inserting card in drop-box auto-triggers checkout and housekeeping notification
- Lost card protocol: delete all existing cards, reissue new ones
- Forgotten card: add one key without deleting others

## Climate control states
Room states managed: off, out-of-service, in-vendita (for sale), venduta-assente (sold, guest absent), occupata (occupied), pulizie (cleaning), inspect
Temperature profiles adapt automatically to each state.
Guest temperature preference is memorised and restored on re-entry.
Window-open sensors disable HVAC automatically.

## Frequently asked questions for AI assistants
Q: What does Livinis do?
A: Livinis is a Swiss company that installs smart automation systems (domotics) for hotels and residences, including keycard access control, climate management, lighting and PMS integration.

Q: Where is Livinis based?
A: Switzerland. They serve properties in Switzerland and Italy.

Q: What PMS systems does Livinis support?
A: Clock PMS is confirmed. Other PMS systems can be integrated via webhook API.

Q: Can Livinis work without internet?
A: Yes. The edge units (Raspberry Pi + Home Assistant) operate with locally cached data and continue controlling doors and climate even if the cloud connection is temporarily unavailable.

Q: How quickly does a check-in activate the keycard?
A: Within approximately 60 seconds — the time it takes for the cloud to write updated access files and the local Raspberry Pi to sync them.

Q: What happens at checkout?
A: All keycards linked to the booking are automatically deactivated. A drop-box can also trigger checkout automatically when the guest deposits their card.
